value.summary: The diff changes the `use openhuman_core::openhuman as oh;` import to `use openhuman_core as oh;`, and correspondingly updates a doc link from `openhuman_core::openhuman::tools::Tool` to `openhuman_core::tools::Tool`.  There is no other code change visible in the diff.  Because the rest of the file (all the tool definitions, the `tool_map` construction, etc.) is not shown, I cannot verify that references to `oh::tools::Tool` etc. still resolve correctly after the path change.  If `openhuman_core` publicly re-exports the `openhuman` module's contents at its top level, the change is sound; if not, it will break the build.  Since I have no way to check the crate's actual public API, I must note this as a potential issue with medium confidence.
